Frontend E2E: /admin/construction loads (construction-page testid) with 4 KPIs (203/79/5-of-14/1), banner cip-hidden-potential shows 'Zugrăveli & Finisaje pereți (1 cereri/90d)', 14 root tax-node elements rendered, 5 marked 'vizibil' matching backend (Handyman 5 spec, HVAC 4, Instalații electrice 3, Instalații sanitare 3, Design interior 6), 'Rulează Visibility Gate' button click emits toast '✅ Visibility gate rulat prin Orchestrator', Projects tab loads proj-table with 3 rows for status=open filter, all filters (proj-filter-category/status/q) + Export CSV button present. Client wizard V2 PASS: v2-nav-request opens wizard, HVAC selection reveals 4 subcategory chips (Aer condiționat, Încălzire, Ventilație, Pompe de căldură), first chip click turns it green, zugravit selection → 0 chips (category is hidden from public tree, correctly returns empty subcategories). Nav sidebar: 'Construction Intelligence' present under Business tab (CIP-A badge), 'Autonomy Orchestrator' present under Infra & Dev → AI & Engineering Lab (SPRINT 1 badge). Regression: GET /api/admin/autonomy/score returns 200 (Autonomy Engine unaffected). No critical or minor issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/construction.py L184-242: _query_projects does city filter POST-fetch in Python instead of Mongo — this is why limit*3 was used (over-fetch to compensate). For high volumes this is O(n) client-side. Consider joining via aggregation $lookup with properties, or denormalize city onto request docs when a request is created. Minor for current data volume.

backend/routes/construction.py POST /taxonomy: `slug = slugify(name)` may collide for two nodes with same name under different parents. There's no uniqueness constraint on (parent_id, slug). If admin creates 'Test' twice they get identical slugs. Not blocking (frontend routes are by id), but worth adding a MongoDB partial unique index on (parent_id, slug) OR appending a suffix.

backend/orchestrator/playbooks.py handle_category_visibility L216 notifies admins on EVERY refresh with hidden_with_potential > 0 — will spam admins because zugravit currently qualifies daily. Consider debounce: only notify when the list CHANGES vs. previous ledger entry, or once per 24h.

backend/construction/taxonomy.py refresh_category_visibility L120-126: writes per-node in a loop → up to 203 individual update_one calls on every refresh. Bulk write (bulk_write with UpdateOne ops) would be one round-trip instead of 203. Not a correctness issue but a hot-path perf improvement (called on every specialist verify).

frontend/pages/admin/ConstructionIntelligencePage.jsx L98: `window.prompt` and L112 `window.confirm` are used for CRUD — works but breaks in Playwright without dialog handler. Consider a lightweight modal for better UX + testability. Not blocking (backend main-agent testing was done).

frontend/pages/admin/ConstructionIntelligencePage.jsx: no client-side error state for taxonomy 404/500 on POST/PATCH — messages surface via setMsg but no dedicated error styling; user sees ❌ prefix only. Fine as MVP.

backend/routes/construction.py /taxonomy POST L98 calls refresh_category_visibility() DIRECTLY (not through orchestrator emit_signal). This bypasses the orchestrator ledger for admin-initiated adds — inconsistent with the CRON path (which uses emit_signal). Consider unifying: always emit_signal so every visibility recompute is auditable. Minor architectural nit.
